Container.Name: gluetun
Container.Overview: gluetun, the VPN client companion traffic goes through. Fill in the VPN settings yourself: Lodestar never asks for or stores them. Its firewall blocks all traffic while the VPN is down. Applying it replaces a container or template you already have with the same name: check first. Create the Docker network first: Unraid starts a container on a network it doesn't know with none.

Config.Name: VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER
Config.Description: You fill this in, from your VPN provider. Lodestar never asks for or stores it.
